title: Introduce geo bulkhead with deferred evictor and traffic quiesce
author: Marco Varela
release_notes: Adds geo-aware bulkhead to isolate regional overloads; introduces deferred-evictor to reduce connection thrash during rapid regional reconvergence; no user-facing API changes.
body:
Summary: This PR adds a geo-aware bulkhead layer (GeoBulkhead) to the routing/orchestration stack and a deferred evictor that batches tenant evictions into a short quiesce window before applying hard eviction. The goal is to reduce cascading regional failovers and to give transient spikes a chance to settle, improving SLO stability during noisy events.

Motivation: We saw recurring incidents where a brief region egress spike caused immediate per-tenant evictions and global rollbacks. That cascade amplified load on sibling regions and produced noisy circuit flips. The GeoBulkhead enforces soft-capacity partitions per-region per-tenant cohort and prefers in-region routing while allowing bounded spill to adjacent regions. The deferred evictor groups eviction decisions into 200-800ms windows (configurable) to avoid rapid churn and to produce a single, observable telemetry event for a tenant rather than many tiny evictions.

Changes:
- Add runtime/workflow component: runtime/geo_bulkhead.go and orchestration/deferred_evictor.go
- Introduce new policy config: routing.geo_bulkhead:{enabled,region_weight_map,spill_threshold} and eviction.deferred_quiesce_ms
- Update admission controller to consult geo bulkhead when selecting a target region
- Add telemetry: metrics.geo_bulkhead.shed_count, metrics.deferred_evictor.batch_size, span attributes for tenant eviction batching
- Add unit + integration tests that simulate multi-region spike and verify no-regression on latency SLOs
- Wire up feature flag: feature.geo_bulkhead rollout via config flags

Backwards compatibility: All config defaults are off. Behavior is gated on tenant-level flags and cluster rollout flags. For Dedicated/Private customers the operator can enable using the console or config file.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (ENG-1987)
- [x] Unit tests added for bulkhead enforcement and deferred-evictor logic
- [x] Integration tests simulating regional spill and reconverge
- [x] Telemetry and tracing added
- [x] Feature-flag gated and can be rolled back by toggling flag in config

What I changed at a glance (commits summary):
commit 1: introduce GeoBulkhead interface and initial router hooks
commit 2: implement deferred evictor and batching window
commit 3: add metrics, tracing spans and annotations
commit 4: integration tests and test harness changes
commit 5: docs + rollout notes + config schema bump

Files changed (high-level):
- runtime/geo_bulkhead.go: new bulkhead implementation and policies
- orchestration/deferred_evictor.go: eviction batching engine
- admission/admission_controller.go: consult geo bulkhead when selecting region
- config/schema.yaml: add geo_bulkhead and eviction.quiesce config
- telemetry/metrics_registry.go: register two new metrics
- tests/integration/geo_bulkhead_test.go: multi-region spike sim harness
- docs/ops/geo-bulkhead.md: operator rollout and rollback instructions

Testing notes: Local unit tests: go test ./... (runtime)
Integration (CI): synthetic multi-region harness run in perf-canary job; CI runs include end-to-end run with mocked regional latencies.
Observed before/after perf numbers in CI: 99th pct latency reduced variance by ~12% under test spike, token-per-second throughput unchanged within noise.

Observability: Added histogram labels for "bulkhead_slot_age" and a tracing annotation "deferred_evictor.batch_id" to help correlate batches with tenant SLO deltas

Rollout plan:
1) Canary enable for internal infra tenants in us-west-2 for 24 hours
2) Expand to production us-east-1 + eu-central with 1% of traffic
3) Gradual ramp to 50% over 72 hours while monitoring metrics.slo_error_budget_burn and metrics.geo_bulkhead.shed_count
4) Full cluster enable if stable (no increase in SLO burn or unexpected evictions)

Rollback plan: Toggle feature.geo_bulkhead=false (instant) and the deferred-evictor will drain pending batches then stop accepting new ones; operator can force immediate revert by setting eviction.force_immediate=true for emergency evacuations

Related work: ENG-2134 (circuit-state stabilization) — this PR coordinates with the circuit-state changes there to make sure evictions don't cause oscillation. SUP-4123 describes a customer incident that motivated this change.

Review notes and questions below.
commits: feat(geo): add GeoBulkhead interface and initial router integration
feat(evictor): deferred-evictor batching engine with configurable quiesce window
chore(test): add integration harness for multi-region spike scenarios
docs(ops): add operator rollout and rollback guidance
review_thread: Aisha Nair: Can you clarify how spill_threshold interacts with existing load-shedding? If a region is at 90% and spill_threshold=0.2, do we still allow spill?

Author (Marco Varela): spill_threshold is the fraction of spill capacity we allow per-cohort; if region at 90% and spill_threshold=0.2 we will allow up to 20% of the tenant's requests to spill, but the admission controller also checks global egress caps so it won't exceed cluster-wide limits.
Samir Patel: I saw the deferred window default at 200ms — that's short but sufficient? Any risk of delaying an eviction that would help protect the region?

Author (Marco Varela): We tuned window in perf lab: 200-800ms emerged as sweet spot to aggregate immediate bursts without materially delaying real sustained overloads. The window is configurable per-cluster and can be lowered to 0ms for immediate eviction if operator prefers.
Elena Gomez: Integration tests flaky on CI once — failure was a timing race in the test harness. Can you add deterministic hooks?
Author (Marco Varela): Added deterministic backoff in tests and a test-only hook to force batch flush; CI reran and passed.
Aisha Nair: Suggest adding an alert when deferred_evictor.batch_size spikes — large batches may indicate congested admission or telemetry issues.
Author (Marco Varela): Added metric alert suggestion to docs and wired a silent telemetry flag to sample large-batch traces for debugging.
Reviewer (Samir Patel): Approve after test flakiness patch; left a nit about comment formatting in deferred_evictor.go
Author (Marco Varela): Addressed nit and pushed fixup.
merge_summary: Squashed 5 commits into 'feat(geo): introduce geo bulkhead and deferred evictor'
